conventions.prf: P = TP/(TP+FP), = 1 if TP+FP = 0; R = TP/(TP+FN), = 1 if TP+FN = 0; F1 = 2PR/(P+R), = 0 if P+R = 0 (same as evaluate_datasets.py)
conventions.micro: TP/FP/FN summed over pairs, then P/R/F1
conventions.macro: mean over pairs of per-pair P, R, F1
conventions.macro_expected_only: macro restricted to pairs with >= 1 expected L2 diagnosis
conventions.ranking: triggered diagnosers sorted by max priority_score (tie: reliability, name); Top-1 = first is an expected diagnoser; RR = 1/rank of the first expected diagnoser (0 if none); MRR = mean RR
conventions.l1: detector counted as fired iff its archived JSON is a non-empty list
